resources.string: Detects which app is opened so SafeKid can block apps your parent has not allowed and show the lock screen. SafeKid does not read screen content, typed text or messages.
Prevents SafeKid from being removed without your parent knowing.
Your parent will be notified that SafeKid protection was turned off.
Rules set by your parent are active.
Ask your parent if you need it.
Your parent has locked this phone. Calls still work.
